name: Billing Charge Method 1 Code
definition: Defines how the billing charge is calculated.

UPRC.name: Unit Priced
UPRC.definition: Charge is calculated as the product of volume times unit price. This is the default value.

STAM.name: Stamp Duty
STAM.definition: Service is specifically identified as a stamp duty for accounting purposes. The charge is calculated as the product of volume times unit price.

BCHG.name: Base Charge
BCHG.definition: Fee charged in addition to the volume times unit price when one or more units of the service are provided.

DPRC.name: Discount Price
DPRC.definition: Charge is calculated using a price which is lower than the quoted bank price.

FCHG.name: Flat Charge
FCHG.definition: Fixed charge not tied to volume or unit price. Flat Charge fees do not require a volume or Unit Price.

LPRC.name: List Price
LPRC.definition: A single service where the volume, original charge and balance required are the totals of two or more pricing tiers.

MCHG.name: Minimum Charge
MCHG.definition: Lowest charge possible for the service.

MXRD.name: Maximum Reduction
MXRD.definition: Maximum charge possible for the service even though volume times unit price exceeds the maximum reduction value.

TIR1.name: Tier 1
TIR1.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 1 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 1 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR2.name: Tier 2
TIR2.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 2 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 2 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR3.name: Tier 3
TIR3.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 3 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 3 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR4.name: Tier 4
TIR4.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 4 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 4 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR5.name: Tier 5
TIR5.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 5 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 5 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR6.name: Tier 6
TIR6.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 6 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 6 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR7.name: Tier 7
TIR7.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 7 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 7 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR8.name: Tier 8
TIR8.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 8 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 8 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TIR9.name: Tier 9
TIR9.definition: Line item represents a charge for tier 9 in a multi tier, volume discount charging structure. Designates the tier 9 used to charge out the volume that falls in that tier.

TPRC.name: Threshold Price
TPRC.definition: Unit price is determined by the total volume.

ZPRC.name: Zone Price
ZPRC.definition: Indicates different prices for the same service. Typically used in a relationship summary statement where the same service has a different price for different accounts in the relationship.

BBSE.name: Balance Based
BBSE.definition: Charge is calculated as a balance times a per-annum rate multiplied by a time factor.
